name: bouncer
description: Decides whether the messages you send while Claude is working get in now or wait until the task is done, with a short note so they fit the work in progress.

model.title: Triage model
model.description: The model that sorts your messages. Haiku is the fastest and cheapest.

timeout.title: Triage time limit (seconds)
timeout.description: Past this, the triage gives up and your message gets in as usual.

language.title: Language of bouncer's notices
language.description: auto follows your system language. The triage explanations always follow the language of your message.
